title: Radio: John Lennon on KSAN-FM | 1974
content:
John Lennon made an appearance on San Francisco radio station KSAN-FM on 21 September 1974.

He was interviewed by Tom ‘Big Daddy’ Donahue for almost three hours, primarily about Lennon’s forthcoming album Walls And Bridges.
